context: A teacher and student discuss a documentary on music
purpose: Teach: オール/まき/捧げ/未熟/ルイ/聴衆/準決勝/脱線

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 若手指揮者の特集、準決勝のオーディションが描かれていました。
lines.en: There was a feature on young conductors—they showed the semi-final auditions.
lines.style: Warm, measured tone. Gentle opening like sharing something she found genuine. Steady pace, conversational. A teacher sharing what moved her, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。オールスター級のオケが、彼に捧げる演奏、感動的でした。
lines.en: Yes. An all-star orchestra performed for him—it was really moving.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Lean slightly forward. Careful articulation on the key moment. No irony, just genuine response. Eyes brightening as he speaks.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本人、まだ未熟と謙遜していましたね。
lines.en: He was quite humble about it, though—said he still has a lot to learn.
lines.style: Thoughtful, appreciative tone. Slight nod embedded in the voice. Slow enough to let the observation settle. Warm recognition of his modesty.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: まきの薪を焚く山小屋で、特訓するシーンも。
lines.en: There was even a scene of him doing intense training in a mountain cabin.
lines.style: Lighter tone, almost conversational curiosity. Small shift in energy—noticing a detail he found interesting. Natural, exploratory pace. Like he's bringing her into the story.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 聴衆の歓声、ルイ・ホールでの最終演奏、印象的でした。
lines.en: The audience's applause during the finals at Louis Hall—that was really striking.
lines.style: Vivid, present-tense energy. Voice opens on the applause image. Let the moment breathe. Slight lift at 'Louis Hall.' Genuinely moved but composed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: コメント、たまに脱線していて、人間味がありましたね。
lines.en: His commentary kept going off on little tangents—it made him feel very human.
lines.style: Warm, affectionate observation. Gentle smile in the voice. Relaxed pace, letting the word 'human' land softly. Genuine fondness for his imperfection.
